name: Hanawa (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Hanawa town emblem in white: a ring enclosing a stylised spiral with a disc.
history: Municipal flag of Hanawa, a town in Fukushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 25 September 1974; the emblem dates from 13 November 1968.

features.role: Hanawa town emblem — a ring enclosing a stylised spiral with a disc
